prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical fantasy sci-fi triptych showing the same silver-haired divine mechanic mage at the moment an ancient mechanical core fully activates, in a brilliant purple arcane-mechanical spectacle.

Canvas: Tall vertical 9:16 composition divided into exactly 3 stacked horizontal cinematic panels with no text, no borders, and continuous violet energy lighting across all panels.

Panel 1, long shot: Show a young silver-haired goddess mechanic mage standing centered in a vast ancient cathedral-like mechanical temple. She wears a white-and-silver ornate techno-mage coat, short skirt, high boots, and metallic accessories, holding a tall staff raised upward. The temple is filled with activated clockwork architecture, circular gears, rune rings, and luminous machinery. Include exactly 11 floating mechanical cubes suspended in the air around the ceiling and sides, each glowing with violet cores and etched circuitry. Include exactly 2 large circular magic diagrams on the left and right foreground walls/floor, plus a central vertical beam of energy descending from above into the raised staff. The floor is glossy black stone covered in glowing circuit traces and reflections. Mood: energy explosion, temple resonance, overwhelming scale.

Panel 2, close-up: Show the same character from chest up, facing forward with calm divine confidence. Her long silver-white hair streams outward in the energy storm, with twin-tail-like flowing sections and small mechanical hair ornaments. Her eyes glow faint violet, and a small luminous circular sigil is marked on her forehead. She wears the same white mechanical mage outfit with visible gears, fasteners, shoulder details, and collar. On the right side of the frame, include exactly 1 ornate staff head or mechanical halo device, a circular clockwork ring radiating purple light. Surround her with violet lightning arcs, transparent magical runes, and swirling energy filaments. Mood: divine awakening, controlling the ancient core.

Panel 3, extreme close-up: Fill the panel with exactly 1 human eye, showing pale lashes and silver hair strands crossing the frame. The iris is transformed into an intricate glowing purple circular mechanism: nested clockwork rings, tiny rune markings, radial circuit lines, and a bright central core. Violet lightning branches across the iris and sclera, with crystalline reflections and wet eye detail. Mood: law engraving, godlike pupil, microscopic arcane machinery.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed anime-realistic fantasy illustration, high-end concept art, ethereal purple palette, luminous violet electricity, ancient machinery, sacred geometry, clockwork magic, crystal-clear sharp detail, cinematic lighting, dramatic depth, glossy reflections, high contrast, volumetric glow, majestic and mystical atmosphere.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 stacked scenes in the order long shot, close-up, extreme eye close-up. Keep the same character identity and costume across all panels. No captions, no logos, no watermark, no extra characters. Dominant color is violet purple; setting is an ancient mechanical temple; core concept is the ancient mechanical core fully activating.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished Japanese proposal-style idea sheet for a casual mobile puzzle game where players collect 3 matching pies to clear them, titled パイを3つ集めて消す カジュアルゲーム 4テーマ案. The sheet should look like a cheerful game design concept board, with cute UI mockups and explanatory diagrams.

Canvas: Wide landscape 16:9 presentation sheet, warm cream background, thin rounded border, tiny sparkles and dessert decorations. Use a soft pastel kawaii illustration style with clean vector-like edges, subtle shadows, glossy game UI highlights, and high readability.

Layout: Divide the canvas into exactly 4 large rounded theme panels arranged in a 2×2 grid. Each panel has a numbered badge, a Japanese theme title banner, a smartphone gameplay mockup on the left, and instruction/example cards on the right. Add a bottom strip with exactly 4 short feature notes and icons.

Main title: At the top center, show a small pie icon followed by the large headline. Emphasize the number “4” in pink and add a small heart at the end.

Panel count and themes: Use exactly 4 theme concepts.
1. Pink dessert cafe theme titled ストロベリースイーツカフェ, with strawberry shortcakes, berry tarts, whipped cream, pink trays, and a cute bunny cafe mascot.
2. Yellow picnic theme titled アニマルピクニック, with a red-checkered picnic cloth, wicker basket tray, small animal friends, fruit pies, and sunny outdoor greenery.
3. Green fantasy woodland theme titled フェアリーフォレストベーカリー, with a magical forest bakery, mushrooms, lanterns, fairy-like character, berry pies, wooden tray, vines, leaves, and warm glowing lights.
4. Blue ocean dessert theme titled オーシャンデザートパーティー, with underwater pastel scenery, coral, shells, sea creatures, shell-shaped desserts, and a shell-decorated tray.

Smartphone mockups: Each of the 4 panels must include exactly 1 vertical phone screen on the left, for a total of 4 phones. Every phone shows a cute match-3-like pie collection game screen with a top HUD showing “Lv.15”, score “2,480”, and a pause button. In each game board, show many individual pies on a themed background, plus a bottom deck/tray with empty slots and a white hand cursor tapping or dragging a pie. Include a small yellow arrow indicating movement toward the tray.

Instruction cards: In each of the 4 panels, include a top explanation card headed “遊び方” with exactly 3 illustrated steps from left to right: tap a pie and put it into the deck, collect 3 of the same pie to clear them, and if the deck becomes full it is GAME OVER. Below it, include exactly 2 smaller example cards: one green/positive card labeled “3つそろえて消える例” showing 3 matching pies clearing with sparkles, and one red/warning card labeled “デッキがいっぱいの例” showing a full tray and the text “GAME OVER” with an exclamation warning icon.

Bottom strip: Add exactly 4 feature notes separated across the bottom, each with one icon: a hand icon with “かんたん操作 / タップだけのシンプル操作！”, a lightbulb icon with “3つそろえる爽快感！ / そろえるとパッと消えて気持ちいい♪”, a heart icon with “かわいいパイがいっぱい！ / 見ているだけで癒される4つの世界♪”, and a warning icon with “デッキが満杯になる前に / うまくそろえてハイスコアを目指そう！”.

Visual constraints: Keep all Japanese text crisp and legible, use rounded friendly fonts, maintain a consistent proposal-board layout, avoid photorealism, avoid dark or gritty styling, avoid extra panels, avoid extra phones, and do not add watermarks or logos.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic physical museum-diorama map titled LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE, showing London at night as a raised 3D architectural archive model on a flat printed cartographic board.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, three-quarter overhead view, dark studio background, the board seen in perspective like a premium museum exhibit or archival planning model. Use a restrained nocturnal palette: deep blue-black paper, navy water, charcoal city blocks, warm amber streetlights, muted gold linework, and subtle cool highlights.

Main diorama: A detailed miniature city map with raised matte buildings, parks, bridges, and river geometry. The River Thames snakes across the center in dark blue, labeled “RIVER THAMES.” Dense street grids glow with tiny amber lights. Major landmarks are slightly taller, more sculptural, and individually illuminated, with thin vertical annotation leader lines rising to labels.

Visible landmark annotations: Include exactly 6 large top-edge labels with leader lines: “BUCKINGHAM PALACE,” “BIG BEN / PALACE OF WESTMINSTER,” “ST. PAUL’S CATHEDRAL,” “THE SHARD,” “THE GHERKIN,” and “CANARY WHARF.” Also include smaller map labels for these 14 places: Regent’s Park, Paddington, Marylebone, Oxford Street, Hyde Park, Green Park, St. James’s Park, Buckingham Palace, Victoria, Westminster, City of London, Southwark, Bermondsey, and Greenwich.

Key raised structures: Emphasize exactly 7 landmark model groups: Buckingham Palace at lower left with glowing frontage, Palace of Westminster and Big Ben beside the river, St. Paul’s Cathedral with a domed roof, The Shard as a bright triangular glass tower, The Gherkin as a dark bullet-shaped tower, Tower Bridge crossing the river in warm light, and Canary Wharf as a cluster of tall golden-lit towers at upper right.

Map and border system: Add a precise archival grid overlay with letters along the top edge and numbers along the side edges, fine gold coordinate lines, double-line border, and thin annotation ticks. Keep the paper surface tactile with visible grain, slight bevel thickness, and realistic cast shadows from raised buildings and label lines.

Bottom information band: Create exactly 5 boxed panels along the bottom. Panel 1 is a legend with exactly 6 icon rows: Major Landmark, Historic Building, Park / Green Space, Water Body, Bridge, Railway Station. Panel 2 is a narrow empty divider/label strip. Panel 3 is the central title block with the title, a subtitle reading “LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL / 地景檔案模型,” an archive code reading LDN-NAM-2024-001, and a dual scale bar in miles and kilometers. Panel 4 contains a decorative compass rose with N/E/S/W markings. Panel 5 contains an “INDEX GRID” mini-map and a small coordinate-system note reading “COORDINATE SYSTEM / BRITISH NATIONAL GRID / TRANSVERSE MERCATOR / OSGB 1936.”

Lighting and material style: Photorealistic editorial render, macro miniature depth, museum-grade craftsmanship, warm amber city illumination against cool blue shadows, matte paper and painted resin buildings, crisp gold typography, shallow atmospheric vignette, no people, no vehicles except tiny indistinct boats on the river, no watermark.

Constraints: Keep the composition consistent and legible as a single physical archive board. Use exact counts for the 6 large top labels, 14 smaller place labels, 7 raised landmark groups, 5 bottom panels, and 6 legend rows. Preserve the archival cartographic aesthetic rather than a modern digital UI.\

She wears a crisp white button-up blouse, a dark fitted mini skirt, sheer black thigh-high stockings, and glossy black pointed heels. She holds an overhead subway hand strap with one raised arm and carries a small black handbag in the other hand. Her face is intentionally pixelated/blurred for anonymity. Around her are seated and standing commuters in business attire, also with some blurred faces. The subway interior has metal poles, hanging hand straps, windowed sliding doors, route maps above the doors, warning stickers, fluorescent lighting, and a muted gray-green floor. The overall feeling is candid, metropolitan, slightly gritty, and fashion-editorial.

Above it, a small italic tagline reads “for commuters, by commuters.” On the upper right, small white issue text reads APR. 2025 on one line and VOL. 47 beneath it. Place cover lines along the left side and one on the lower right, using a mix of white serif headlines and smaller pink subtext. Add a barcode block at the bottom left.

Barcode details: Bottom-left white barcode label with black bars, small text “URBANIST Vol.47,” issue marker “04>,” and digits resembling “9 771234 567003.”

Visual style: Photorealistic smartphone candid photo blended with polished magazine-cover design, natural subway lighting, slight motion blur outside the train window, muted cool gray environment contrasted with the soft pink masthead. Typography should feel like a modern fashion/lifestyle magazine: elegant serif display type, clean alignment, strong hierarchy.

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vintage Chinese illustrated travel map of Yunnan Tea Horse Road Map, showing an ancient caravan route through Yunnan as a hand-painted parchment atlas.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster on aged tan rice paper with frayed texture, subtle stains, ink wash borders, and muted mineral pigments. The overall look should resemble an antique Qing-dynasty travel scroll mixed with a fantasy historical map.

Layout: Center the silhouette map of Yunnan as a large irregular province shape, divided into exactly 8 color-tinted regions with soft ink outlines. A winding beige caravan road enters from the lower left, snakes through the center, and exits near the upper middle, connecting all major stops. Around the province, add faint monochrome mountains, rivers, clouds, and empty parchment space.

Title and side text: On the right edge, place a large vertical black-brush Chinese title reading “云南茶马古道图”, with a smaller vertical English subtitle “YUNNAN TEA HORSE ROAD MAP” beside it. Add small vertical Chinese calligraphy notes on the upper left and lower right, plus two red square seal stamps near the title and notes.

Map regions: Include exactly 8 labeled regions, each with a large Chinese place name and a smaller descriptive sublabel: 1) northwest green region, “迪庆”, with Tibetan monasteries and two pagodas; 2) west blue region, “丽江”, with an ancient town, tiled roofs, and arched bridge; 3) central golden region, “大理”, with three white pagodas by a lake; 4) east orange region, “昆明”, with stone forest pinnacles and a gate; 5) southwest pale green region, “保山”, with a market town and bridge; 6) south-central earthy green region, “普洱”, with terraced tea mountains and tea transport crates; 7) southeast blue-green region, “玉溪”, with Fuxian Lake scenery; 8) far south dark green region, “西双版纳”, with tropical tea forest, elephant, and Dai-style buildings.

Route details: Show exactly 3 road styles in a small legend at lower left: main Tea Horse Road as a solid dark line, branch route as a dashed line, and main trading post as a red dot. Add a small compass rose labeled north, south, east, and west above the legend.

Caravan elements: Along the road, depict exactly 6 visible caravan groups: 1) a small group leaving the lower-left corner with people and pack animals; 2) a foreground group with two loaded horses and one handler near Pu’er; 3) a mid-route group with three loaded pack animals climbing toward Dali; 4) a group passing the Dali pagodas; 5) a group entering the Diqing mountain route; 6) a tiny distant group near the top road. Use brown horses and mules with stacked tea bundles and a few robed travelers.

Decorative elements: Add exactly 4 major botanical/animal decorations outside or near the map: 1) a leafy tea branch along the left side; 2) a tea plant cluster in the lower center; 3) tropical broad leaves and flowers at the lower right; 4) a blue-green peacock standing at the bottom right. Add one red seal block at the bottom left reading “茶马古道”.

Visual style: Fine black ink linework, watercolor wash, antique cartographic illustration, Chinese landscape painting, misty mountains, delicate river lines, traditional brush calligraphy, warm sepia parchment background, muted teal, ochre, jade green, blue, and rust colors. Keep the image richly detailed but harmonious and aged.

Constraints: Preserve the vertical poster composition, use readable hand-brushed Chinese labels, avoid modern roads, cars, buildings, icons, bright digital colors, photorealism, or clean vector graphics. No watermark.\

title: 单色动漫恐怖电影海报
author: ジュニ＠Multi AI Creator
categories: 海报 / 传单,水墨 / 中国风,漫画 / 图像小说,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en: A haunting monochrome Japanese animated movie poster in gritty ink-wash and charcoal style, high contrast black, white, and gray only, with a tall vertical composition. The scene is viewed from inside a dark room toward an open doorway. On the right stands a young boy in silhouette, seen from behind in three-quarter view, with short messy hair, wearing a black-and-white horizontal striped T-shirt, loose dark pants, and sneakers, quietly staring out through the door. The left side shows the open wooden door itself, rough and weathered, with a visible round knob and a vertical line of Japanese text painted on it that reads 「開けたのは、ぼくじゃない」. Beyond the doorway is a surreal towering mountain or jagged monolith, centered in the distance, painted like a hand-drawn ink illustration, with a glowing white zigzag path or crack snaking from the base to a bright opening near the summit. Small floating rock fragments hover around the mountain. At the foot of the mountain, exactly 4 tiny human silhouettes stand together on a dark ridge facing it. The bright doorway light spills into the room and transforms into a long black shadow stretching toward the viewer across the wooden floor; at the end of that shadow is a demonic face shape with exactly 2 white almond-shaped eyes embedded in the darkness. The floorboards and walls are crosshatched and heavily textured, creating an eerie psychological horror atmosphere. Add Japanese festival-style laurels and release copy on the upper right in 3 stacked award blocks with elegant serif typography, plus large release date text reading “8.28 ROADSHOW”. Place the film title huge across the lower middle in distressed white hand-painted letters: “RAISE”, with smaller katakana beneath it reading 「レイズ」. Add a Japanese tagline centered along the bottom above the credits: 「君の『影』が、世界を救う。」 Include dense, tiny Japanese credit lines and a website at the very bottom, styled like a real theatrical poster. Overall mood: ominous, poetic, surreal coming-of-age horror fantasy, indie anime film poster, dramatic negative space, cinematic poster design, unsettling but beautiful.\

title: 蒸汽朋克身高差海报
author: CapCut.Japan
categories: 海报 / 传单,信息图 / 教育视觉,动漫 / 漫画,水彩,群像 / 情侣,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a nostalgic vertical height-difference character poster in a warm steampunk anime storybook style, showing an enormous gentle robot and a small child standing beside a central measuring ruler.

Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, 3:4 ratio, aged parchment texture with a pale blue-green background, sepia stains, thin decorative brown border, slightly worn corners, soft watercolor-and-ink illustration finish.

Layout: Place a full-body steampunk robot on the left, towering to about 250 cm, and a small young girl on the right, about 110 cm tall. A vertical height ruler runs down the exact center from 0 cm at the bottom to 250 cm at the top, with centimeter tick marks and labeled increments every 10 cm. At the top center, add a small vintage label plaque reading 「身長計」. The robot gently bends or reaches down, and the girl reaches up so their fingers touch around the 110 cm mark, creating a tender height-gap scene.

Subject details: The left character is a 250 cm antique brass steampunk robot named クロノ, bulky but kind, covered in riveted metal plates, exposed gears, pipes, gauges, clock faces, round glass lenses, a large wind-up key on its back, and a small smokestack releasing a soft puff of steam. The right character is a 110 cm little girl named メイ, cute anime style, wearing rolled dark green overalls, a cream striped long-sleeve shirt, brown shoes, and an orange hair ribbon tying a side ponytail. Keep the child’s face softly simplified or obscured, with the body language expressing affection and trust.

Text content: Include exactly 2 top character information cards, one at upper left and one at upper right. Left card text: 「おなまえ」, “Name”, 「クロノ」, 「身長」, “Height”, “250cm”. Right card text: 「おなまえ」, “Name”, 「メイ」, 「身長」, “Height”, “110cm”. Add the large Japanese phrase 時を超えた絆 in brown calligraphy on the right-center area. Add exactly 2 comic thought bubbles: one near the robot around the upper center saying 守るよ with a small heart and gear doodles, and one near the girl on the right saying 大好き with stars, sparkles, and a smiling face doodle.

Visual style: Nostalgic Japanese illustrated poster, whimsical steampunk fantasy, delicate linework, muted browns, brass, cream, and faded teal tones, softly shaded, textured paper grain, hand-drawn measuring scale, warm emotional atmosphere.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 characters, exactly 2 information cards, exactly 2 thought bubbles, and one central height scale labeled 0–250 cm. Keep all typography vintage brown, preserve the Japanese text exactly where specified, avoid modern UI elements, avoid photorealism, no extra characters, no watermark.\

title: 重叠的 SaaS 功能卡

categories: 应用 / 网页设计,极简主义,插画,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean landing-page hero visual showing three overlapping white SaaS feature cards for a sales intelligence / lead monitoring product, in a premium minimal Figma-style mockup.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, warm off-white background with very soft beige gradient, subtle vignette, realistic soft shadows under cards. Cards are tall rounded rectangles with slight perspective tilt and depth, floating in the center. Use elegant editorial serif typography for large headings and small sans-serif labels.

Layout: Arrange exactly 3 vertical cards, overlapping horizontally. The left card is in front and tilted slightly counterclockwise, the middle card is centered and nearly upright, the right card sits behind and tilted slightly clockwise. Keep generous whitespace and rounded corners.

Card 1, left card — capture sources: At the top left place a small orange circular logo icon with abstract white marks. Near the top center place a pale peach pill label reading “CAPTURA”. Large headline in Portuguese: “12+ fontes escutando seu mercado 24h”. Below it, show exactly 12 small rounded source tiles in a 3-column by 4-row grid, each with an icon and label. The 12 labels are: “Notícias”, “LinkedIn”, “Reddit”, “Google”, “Podcasts”, “X (Twitter)”, “YouTube”, “Trustpilot”, “Blogs”, “Wikipédia”, “Comunidades”, “e mais”. Use recognizable simplified icons: globe, LinkedIn logo, Reddit alien, Google G, podcast glyph, X logo, YouTube play button, green trust star, document/blog icon, W, group/community dots, plus sign.

Card 2, center card — match score: Place a pale green pill label reading “ENTENDE”. Main headline text: “ICP Match 94%”. Center a thick circular donut progress ring in bright orange, almost complete, with pale peach remainder. Inside the ring, display “94%” in large serif type and a tiny subtitle “de compatibilidade”. Below the ring place exactly 3 thin rounded checklist rows with small green check icons and the labels: “Perfil ideal identificado”, “Sinais alinhados”, “Alta intenção detectada”.

Card 3, right card — action scheduling: Place a dark green pill label reading “AGE”. Large headline in Portuguese: “Reunião agendada automaticamente”. Below it, include a compact calendar widget headed “Maio 2025” with weekday labels in Portuguese: “SEG”, “TER”, “QUA”, “QUI”, “SEX”, “SÁB”, “DOM”. Show a monthly grid of dates with the 15 highlighted by an orange circle. Add small left and right chevrons near the calendar header. At the bottom, include a confirmation block with an orange calendar icon and the text “Reunião confirmada”, “15 de maio, 10:00”, and a green dot followed by “Google Meet”.

Visual style: High-end SaaS landing page aesthetic, soft 3D paper cards, off-white surfaces, thin pale gray dividers, muted green and orange accent colors, subtle shadows, crisp vector UI icons, refined typography, realistic but clean product mockup.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 cards, exactly 12 source tiles on the left card, exactly 3 checklist rows on the middle card, and one calendar widget on the right card. Keep all text legible, no people, no extra logos beyond the specified source icons, no watermark, no browser chrome.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create an ultra-high-resolution, highly detailed storyboard sheet for a 15-second animated cooking video about golden fried rice. The sheet should clearly show the finished video sequence in chronological order and strongly stimulate appetite.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet, cinematic wide format, divided into exactly 12 equal rectangular panels arranged in a 4 columns by 3 rows grid. Use thick black borders between panels and a thin black outer frame. No captions, no numbering, no watermark.

Visual style: Premium animated feature-film cooking style, gourmet anime food sakuga, cinematic lighting, high detail, shallow depth of field, warm golden tones, dramatic steam, sparkling oil, glossy egg texture, individual rice grains, appetizing color contrast, dynamic camera angles, realistic motion blur, intense wok flames, ultra-crisp food rendering.

Storyboard panels, exactly 12 in chronological order:
1. Overhead mise en place on a wooden table: a bowl of white rice, three brown eggs, a bowl of sliced pork or ham, minced meat, chopped green onions, garlic, soy sauce, small sauce bowls, warm morning kitchen light.
2. Close-up of a chef’s hands chopping green onions on a cutting board with a shiny knife, diced scallions scattering, shallow depth of field.
3. Close-up of two hands cracking an egg over a clear bowl, golden yolk and transparent egg white stretching and splashing with tiny droplets.
4. Close-up of eggs being beaten in a bowl with chopsticks, vivid orange-yellow swirling mixture, glossy spiral motion.
5. Oil being poured into a smoking black wok over a blue gas flame, ripples and reflections in the hot oil, steam rising.
6. Beaten egg poured into the hot wok, fluffy golden curds forming instantly, bubbling oil and steam.
7. Rice, chopped green onions, and minced meat falling into the wok over scrambled egg, ingredients suspended midair, abundant individual grains and colorful bits.
8. Dynamic wok-tossing shot with intense orange flames surrounding the pan, fried rice arcing through the air, chef’s hand holding the handle at the right edge.
9. Extreme close-up of finished fried rice texture: golden rice grains, fluffy egg chunks, pork bits, green onion slices, glossy oil sheen.
10. Side action shot of the chef tossing the fried rice in the wok over flames and steam, particles flying, dramatic cinematic backlight.
11. Plating shot: a steaming mound of golden fried rice served in a patterned blue-and-white bowl on a kitchen counter, spoon or ladle adding the final portion, cozy background blur.
12. Final appetizing hero close-up: a spoonful of golden fried rice lifted toward the camera, visible egg, pork, green onions, and glossy separated grains, background bowl softly blurred.

Constraints: Keep the exact 12-panel 4x3 storyboard layout, no visible text, no extra panels, no people’s faces, emphasize chronological cooking action, make every panel look like a polished frame from a high-budget animated cooking film.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a premium vertical Japanese marketing poster for Claude Code, promoting AI coding automation and smarter development.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, 768×1024 style, cinematic editorial photography with dark warm tones, shallow depth of field, soft window light, subtle film grain, high-end SaaS advertisement aesthetic.

Main visual: A realistic workspace scene in a modern cafe or studio. On the right, an adult Japanese man in a dark knit sweater sits at a wooden table, leaning forward with one hand near his chin; his face is covered by a plain opaque warm-brown rectangular privacy block. He has messy black hair visible above the block. On the left foreground, an open laptop displays a dark terminal window with Claude Code-like command-line output, checkmarks, generated files, and project-complete messages. Add a ceramic coffee cup, a notebook with pen, and two stacked programming books on the table; one book spine reads “Clean Code.” Background is blurred with plants and interior glass, muted green and brown palette.

Top headline area: Large elegant Japanese serif typography in white, placed upper left, reading 「考える力を、コードに変える。」 with generous line spacing and a refined magazine-ad feel. Under it, add a smaller subheading: 「Claude Codeと、AI時代の開発をスマートに。」 Then add a short Japanese body paragraph explaining that Claude Code understands thinking and supports design, implementation, and improvement as an AI coding partner.

Feature panel: Place one translucent glassmorphism card in the lower-right middle, with a thin white border and soft blur. Card title: 「開発を加速する、Claude Codeの主な機能」. Include exactly 5 feature rows, each with a simple outlined icon on the left, a bold Japanese feature label, and a smaller Japanese description. The 5 rows are: 1) speech bubble icon, 「自然言語でのコーディング支援」; 2) gear icon, 「プロジェクト全体を理解」; 3) pencil icon, 「リファクタリングもワンクリック」; 4) document icon, 「テスト・ドキュメントも自動生成」; 5) terminal window icon, 「CLIでシームレスに統合」. End the card with the line 「あなたの開発体験を、よりスマートに、より創造的に。」

Metrics: In the lower-left area, show exactly 2 large numerical proof points in white serif type: first metric label 「開発時間」 with value 「最大 55% 削減」 and a tiny footnote; second metric label 「バグの早期発見率」 with value 「2.3倍 向上*」.

Footer: Add a full-width dark translucent footer bar at the bottom. Left text: 「Claude Code Insight」 followed by a divider and 「ハウツー」. Right text: 「AIコーディングの実践知とノウハウを発信中 ▶」.

Visual style: Sophisticated Japanese tech magazine advertisement, photorealistic but with polished layout overlays, cream-white typography, thin lines, restrained contrast, warm shadows, no bright neon colors.

Constraints: Keep the composition text-heavy but clean and readable. Use exactly 1 main person, 1 laptop, 1 coffee cup, 1 notebook, 1 pen, 2 visible stacked books, 1 feature card, 5 feature rows, and 2 metric blocks. Do not add logos beyond the product name. Preserve the Japanese text exactly where specified.\

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster on a dark charcoal textured background, high-resolution, realistic 3D product-render look, muted tactical colors, tan and black rifle parts, beige military stencil typography.

Layout: At the top left, place a large title reading “M2010 ESR” with the subtitle “ENHANCED SNIPER RIFLE” underneath. Below it add a short description: “The M2010 Enhanced Sniper Rifle (ESR) is a 7.62×51mm NATO precision bolt-action rifle adopted by the U.S. Army in 2010 as the upgrade to the M24 Sniper Weapon System.” The upper half is dominated by a large three-quarter view of the rifle angled from lower left to upper right, with scope, bipod, long barrel, muzzle brake, adjustable stock, pistol grip, magazine, and free-float handguard visible.

Callouts and text: Include exactly 3 component callouts around the large rifle: “MIL-STD-1913 Accessory Rail,” “5 or 10 Round Detachable Magazine,” and “Adjustable Stock (Length of Pull & Cheek Weld).” Add a “FEATURES” block with exactly 6 bullet points: “Accuracy and effective range improved over M24,” “Modular design for easier maintenance and upgrades,” “Adjustable stock for length of pull and cheek weld,” “Match-grade barrel for enhanced precision,” “Free-float handguard with accessory rail,” and “Compatible with sound suppressors.”

Specifications panel: On the right side of the upper rifle, include a boxed table titled “SPECIFICATIONS” with exactly 9 rows: Caliber: 7.62×51mm NATO; Action: Bolt-action; Overall Length: 48.5 in (1,230 mm); Barrel Length: 24 in (610 mm); Weight: 14.8 lb (6.7 kg) w/ scope & bipod; Magazine Capacity: 5 or 10 rounds; Effective Range: 800–1,000 m; Maximum Range: 1,500 m+; Sights: Leupold Mark 4 6.5–20×50mm.

Middle diagram: Add a second full side-profile view of the same rifle across the center, perfectly horizontal, smaller than the top render. Add measurement lines showing “48.5 in (1,230 mm)” above the rifle and “8.6 in (218 mm)” vertically near the stock.

Detail section: At the bottom, create a grid titled “DETAIL VIEWS” with exactly 6 close-up panels in two rows of three. The panels are: 1) “Muzzle Brake” with subtext “Reduces recoil and muzzle rise”; 2) “Free-Float Handguard” with subtext “Improves accuracy by minimizing barrel contact”; 3) “Bolt Action” with subtext “Smooth, reliable, and proven design”; 4) “Adjustable Stock” with subtext “Customizable for shooter fit and comfort”; 5) “Detachable Magazine” with subtext “5 or 10 round options for operational flexibility”; 6) “Leupold Mark 4 Scope” with subtext “6.5–20× magnification for long-range precision.”

Visual style: Photorealistic tactical catalog rendering, subtle rim lighting, crisp labels and thin pointer lines, slight vignette, professional defense-industry spec sheet aesthetic. Keep all text legible, use only the listed text, and do not add people, logos, flags, watermarks, or extra weapons.\

prompt_en: Create a highly detailed scientific anatomical poster of a neuron on a clean warm off-white paper background, presented as a museum-quality hybrid of 3D pencil drawing and ultra-realistic biological illustration. The composition centers on one large neuron in three-quarter view, with an oversized spherical purple nucleus inside a textured cell body, many branching dendrites spreading outward like winter tree branches, and a long axon extending diagonally down to the right. The axon is partially cut away to reveal its internal structure and is wrapped in segmented blue-gray myelin sheaths with visible gaps at the nodes of Ranvier. Include fine serif typography, delicate leader lines, small circled numbers on the main neuron, and the feel of an elegant old scientific plate mixed with modern biomedical visualization. Goal: Create a colorful four-panel scene-design concept sheet for a cozy retro kitchen, in a whimsical flat 2D illustration style inspired by 1980s/1990s animation background art.

Canvas: Wide horizontal image, 16:9 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 4 rectangular panels by thin white gutters: two panels across the top row and two panels across the bottom row.

Setting: A bright, playful retro kitchen with emerald green cabinets, pink trim, peach countertops, leafy trees visible outside the windows, and a warm pastel palette. Use clean ink lines, slightly imperfect hand-drawn perspective, screen-print-like colors, and cozy lived-in details.

Panel layout and contents:
- Panel 1, top left: wide eye-level view of the kitchen. Show green upper and lower cabinets, a black refrigerator covered with round magnets and stickers, a pink-and-white checkered towel, two tall windows with greenery outside, a peach counter, small appliances, a sink area, pendant lighting, and a central peach table. On the table are exactly 3 main objects: a plate of donuts, an open newspaper, and a pink bottle or condiment container. Include two mismatched chairs, one black and one pink.
- Panel 2, top right: upward-looking corner view emphasizing ceiling, pendant lights, upper cabinets, tall windows, and angled kitchen architecture. Show exactly 2 hanging pendant bulbs and cabinet doors tilted in perspective, with greenery visible through the windows.
- Panel 3, bottom left: close-up tabletop still life. Show a large peach tabletop with exactly 3 main object groups: a yellow plate holding assorted donuts, a spread of newspapers/magazines, and two pink table items consisting of one small cup/can and one tall bottle. The donut plate should contain exactly 7 visible donuts or pastries in varied colors, including pink frosted, chocolate, cream, and plain rings.
- Panel 4, bottom right: high overhead floor-plan view of the same kitchen. Show a black-and-white checkerboard floor, green cabinetry around the perimeter, pink countertops, windows, refrigerator, sink, stove, and the central table. On the table repeat exactly 3 object groups: donut plate, newspaper pile, and pink bottles/cups. Include exactly 2 chairs, one pink and one black.

Visual style: Saturated candy colors, teal-green cabinetry, bubblegum pink accents, peach table surfaces, black-and-white checkerboard floor, cream walls, simplified shapes, charmingly skewed perspective, retro anime background feel, crisp outlines, no photorealism.

Text: Newspapers may contain tiny illegible decorative print only; do not include readable headlines, logos, captions, watermarks, or UI elements.

Constraints: Keep all 4 panels consistent as views of the same kitchen scene. Preserve the cheerful retro color palette and hand-drawn illustrative look. Do not add people, pets, speech bubbles, or extra panels.\
